name: JellyfinDownloader
description: Orchestrates media downloads by bridging Jellyfin with the JellyDL service.
overview: Enable users to download media files (movies, series, etc.) in a simple and integrated manner.

versions.changelog:
### Changed
- Switched distribution strategy to a hybrid Public/Private model using a secondary public repository (`JDLRepo`).
- Updated release workflow to automatically publish to the public repository.
- Removed local manifest server (docker-compose) and local releases folder.

### Added
- Initial release of JellyfinDownloader plugin.
- Integration with JellyDL API.
- Download monitoring interface with real-time updates.
- Folder picker for selecting download destinations.
- Support for multiple download links submission.
- Integration with Plugin Pages and File Transformation plugins.
- Configuration page for server URL, API Key, and security paths.
- Folder creation and safe deletion within the folder picker.
